newsitem.title: GREECE: Hellenic Biscuits says Q3 profit up 11.7pc.
newsitem.headline: Hellenic Biscuits says Q3 profit up 11.7pc.

text.p: Hellenic Biscuits said its pretax profit rose 11.7 percent to 637 million drachmas in the first eight months of the year from 570 million in the same period a year earlier on sales growth of 10 percent at 11.5 billion.
"Our new snack products RICH and SUPERKID were a significant factor behind the rise. Sales revenue from these products will reach 600 million drachmas by year end," the company said.
Hellenic Biscuits said the high seasonality of sales in the second half coupled with primary input prices and a continuing drop in the cost of money bode well for its full year results.
"Our sales support programme planned for the fourth quarter includes a dynamic advertising and promotional campaign," it said.
The company expectes to close the year with sales above 20 billion drachmas and pretax earnings of about 1.7 billion, it said.
Shares of Hellenic Biscuit closed down 25 drachmas at 1,115 on light volume on Tuesday.
